scope: Project-level lifecycle observations for the Tehachapi Renewable Transmission Project. Each record preserves its own source, cost definition, dollar year, and exact locator; amounts must not be summed across records without first aligning their definitions and dollar years.

records.status: CPUC granted a consolidated maximum-cost increase from $257.60M to $746.00M for Segments 1–3
records.path_scope: For Segments 2–3, the approved route is SCE’s proposal as modified by Option A and SCE’s July 18, 2008 map set; see the decision’s Attachment 2.
records.cost_method: CPUC maximum reasonable and prudent cost; excludes AFUDC. This is a combined Segments 1–3 cap, not an allocated project cost.
records.source_locator: Decision 09-09-033, Summary (PDF p. 2): consolidated maximum cost increased from $257.60M to $746.00M; Attachment 2, Ordering Paragraph 1 (PDF p. 30) for the Segment 2–3 route language.

records.status: CPUC granted CPCN using the Environmentally Superior Alternative
records.location: Kern, Los Angeles, and San Bernardino Counties; Tehachapi Wind Resource Area to load in Los Angeles and San Bernardino Counties
records.path_scope: 173-mile transmission line, Segments 4–11; the Commission selected the Environmentally Superior Alternative rather than SCE’s originally proposed alignment in some locations.
records.capacity: Up to 4,500 MW total TRTP capability
records.cost_method: CPUC: $1,522.920M maximum reasonable cost in 2009 dollars excluding AFUDC; AFUDC estimated at $261.820M, for estimated total project cost of $1,784.740M. The displayed amount is the stated total including estimated AFUDC.
records.source_locator: Decision 09-12-044, Findings of Fact 43 (PDF p. 100) and Ordering Paragraph 3 (PDF p. 105) for cost; Summary (PDF p. 5) for CPCN/alternative/capacity; §6.2.1 (PDF p. 30) for 173 miles.
records.source_title: CPUC Decision 09-12-044 — CPCN for the Tehachapi Renewable Transmission Project (Segments 4–11)

records.status: CPUC upheld, as modified, the requirement to underground Segment 8A through Chino Hills
records.approval: CPUC rehearing denied; Decision 13-07-018 requirement retained
records.path_scope: Scope/routing change: Segment 8A through Chino Hills is required to be undergrounded rather than built as the prior overhead configuration.
records.cost_method: No cost is entered on this record. The later Decision 14-01-005 independently records the $23M UG5 voltage-control change; do not infer a Segment 8A total from this status record.
records.source_locator: Decision 13-10-076, Introduction (PDF p. 1) and Background (PDF pp. 2–3): Decision 13-07-018 required Segment 8A undergrounding through Chino Hills and rehearing was denied.
records.source_title: CPUC Decision 13-10-076 — Modifying and Denying Rehearing of Decision 13-07-018

records.status: CPUC approved reactive compensation / voltage-control equipment for UG5 in Segment 8A and increased the project maximum cost
records.path_scope: UG5 underground option in Segment 8A; scope change adds not more than 450 Mvar reactive compensation / voltage-control within the Mira Loma Substation footprint.
records.capacity: Not more than 450 Mvar reactive compensation / voltage control
records.cost_method: Incremental CPUC maximum-cost increase only: approximately $23M in 2013 dollars. It is not a total project cost and must not be added to the 2009 total without aligning cost definitions and dollar years.
records.source_locator: Decision 14-01-005, Summary (PDF p. 1); §4.2 (PDF p. 11); Findings of Fact 3 and Ordering Paragraph 1(c) (PDF pp. 14–16). The decision separately reports that Decision 13-07-018 had added $224M (2013$) for UG5 (PDF p. 11).
records.source_title: CPUC Decision 14-01-005 — Granting, in Part, SCE’s Petition for Modification of Decision 13-07-018

records.status: SCE petitioned CPUC to revise maximum-cost findings after construction; SCE states the project was in service as of December 2016
records.approval: SCE filing only — not a CPUC-approved cost finding
records.location: Tehachapi Wind Resource Area to Los Angeles and San Bernardino Counties
records.path_scope: Project-wide post-construction cost filing for TRTP Segments 4–11.
records.cost_method: SCE-reported estimated actual construction cost in constant 2016 dollars. The filing states prior CPUC cost findings totaled $2,010M (2016$); $2,709M is SCE’s requested revised maximum-cost finding, not a CPUC approval.
records.source_locator: SCE Petition for Modification, p. 3 (PDF p. 9): in service December 2016, prior cost findings $2,010M (2016$), and estimated actual construction cost $2,709M (2016$); Table 1 (PDF p. 10) confirms the total.
records.source_title: SCE Petition for Modification of Decisions 09-12-044, 13-07-018, and 14-01-005
